## Manual QA Scope

### S2-05: On-Device Touch Coordinate Verification (Advisory)
**Evidence file**: `production/qa/evidence/sort_mechanic_input_device_test.md`
**Required before**: `/team-qa` sign-off

- [ ] Tap on leftmost column selects only leftmost stack (no adjacent column bleed)
- [ ] Tap on rightmost column selects correctly on 2-column and 8-column board
- [ ] Tap center of each stack always dispatches to that stack (2–8 column counts)
- [ ] No phantom taps between columns (dead-zone respected)

### S2-09: App-Pause On-Device Verification (Advisory)
**Evidence file**: `production/qa/evidence/sort_mechanic_pause_device_test.md`
**Required before**: `/team-qa` sign-off

- [ ] Hold bolt; press Android Home; return to app → bolt back in source stack
- [ ] Board total bolt count correct after resume (no missing bolt regression)
- [ ] Sort Mechanic in IDLE on resume — bolt NOT still held
- [ ] New move can be committed immediately after resume (no stuck state)
